prerequisites: linear algebra (solution of system of equations)

learning_outcomes.text: Get knowledge of basic methods of solving linear circuits (circuits analysis), steady and transient state of circuits, basic characteristics of frequency filters, Maxwell equations (integral and derivative form), electromagnetic waves on conductors and in free space.

Students are able to orientate in electrostatics, steady currents, static magnetic field, electromagnetic fields, Maxwell equations and wave propagation problems. They can analyze DC and AC circuits (transients and steady states).

syllabus_topics: DC & AC circuits - Ohm's Law, Kirchhoff's Law, Current Loop Method, Voltage Node Method, Thevenin's and Norton's theorem
Transient and steady state of linear circuits - differential equations, Laplace Transform
Laws in electrostatics - Electric Intensity, Induction, Potential, Voltage
degree: Bachelor's programme, Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Informatics - courses in English
